brief:
Yair Lapid accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of attempting to engineer a coup, Shehab Wire reported, citing an investigation broadcast by Israel's Channel 12 on Sunday. The probe revealed security operations targeting Arab political activists and an alleged effort to wiretap the phones of five Knesset members on election day.

The investigation detailed surveillance activities conducted during the electoral process, implicating Netanyahu's government in moves against opposition figures and lawmakers.

title: Lapid accuses Netanyahu of orchestrating a coup attempt
